d.t: Water Resisting and Crystalline Waterproofing Concrete Admixture
d.s: Sika WT-200 P is a combined water resisting and crystalline waterproofing admixture used to reduce the permeability of concrete and to enhance the self-healing abilities of the concrete.
a: Enhancement of self-healing properties of the concrete
Improvement in resistance against chemical attack
us: Sika WT-200 P has been specifically formulated to produce high quality waterproof concrete. Sika WT-200 P treated concrete is used as a part of the Sika Watertight Concrete System.
Sika WT-200 P can be used in any below / in / above ground watertight structures such as:
Underground commercial facilities (malls, transportation hubs etc.)
d.pk: 1.75 kg pulpable bags (6 bags/sealed plastic bucket)

sec.t: Conforms to the requirements of AS1478.1 , type Special Purpose normal setting Sika WT-200 P is approved for potable water use (AS4020-2005)
Mixture of cements, amino alcohols and fillers
12 months from date of production if stored in unopened and undamaged original sealed containers.
Storage at temperatures between 5 °C and 35 °C. Protect from direct sunlight, moisture, frost and contamination.

The standard rules of good concreting practice, concerning production and placing, are to be followed. Laboratory trials shall be carried out before concreting on site, especially when using a new mix design or producing new concrete components. Fresh concrete must be cured properly and curing applied as early as possible.

For waterproof concrete: Concrete mix design depends on local requirements and / or local standards for watertight concrete systems. For Sika Watertight Concrete: Sika WT-200 P has been formulated for use in concrete with a minimum binder content of 350 kg/m³ and a maximum w/b-ratio of 0.45. Depending on the specific mix design the dosage of HRW /superplasticizer has to be evaluated in order to achieve a consistency ≥110 mm (slump test AS1012.3.1) Laboratory trials are always recommended to evaluate and confirm actual water reduction and consistency class.
The chemical and physical composition of the components, concrete, Sika WT-200 P and concrete and ambient temperature can affect the setting time of the concrete.

Sika WT-200 P is added at the time of batching to the concrete.Depending on the operation it can be dosed At the dry batching plant : add Sika WT-200 P either to the gauging / mixing water to form a very thin slurry and add it into the truck barrel or load it along with the concrete components. Then mix thoroughly for about 60 seconds/m3 . Do not add Sika WT-200 P to wet concrete. At the wet batching plant (mixer) : dispense Sika WT-200 P and the concrete components together, mixing as per the internal production procedures. The w/b-ratio and consistency control remains the responsibility of the concrete producer.

Sika WT-200 P may be combined with many other Sika products. Note: Always conduct trials before combining products in specific mixes and contact Sika technical service for more information and advice.
1–2 % of Sika WT-200 P by weight of binder

handling.label: Advice on safe handling
handling.text: Do not breathe vapours/dust. Sika 03 Avoid exceeding the given occupational exposure limits (see section 8). Do not get in eyes, on skin, or on clothing. For personal protection see section 8. Persons with a history of skin sensitisation problems or asthma, allergies, chronic or recurrent respiratory disease should not be employed in any process in which this mixture is being used. Smoking, eating and drinking should be prohibited in the application area. Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products
